info.title: Cardiac Care Tips
info.description: Patient-education tips for people living with heart disease: a searchable library across nutrition, activity, medication, monitoring and lifestyle, plus a daily rotating tip, per-user favourites, and a fixed set of emergency warning signs. General education only — not a substitute for an individual's own care plan.

get.summary: Readiness probe used by the platform.
Report the signed-in user's identity from the platform's SSO headers.
get.description: Reads X-Forwarded-Email / X-Forwarded-User, which the platform's auth proxy injects when Google SSO is enabled. Both are null when SSO is off, on public paths, or in local development. The browser cannot read these headers, so this endpoint is how the frontend asks who is signed in.

200.description: The caller's identity, or nulls when unknown.

get.summary: List the tip categories with how many tips each contains.
get.description: Returns categories in display order, with any category present in the database but unknown to the backend appended afterwards.

get.summary: Search and filter the tip library.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Restrict to one category slug, e.g. nutrition or warning.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across title, body, rationale and source. Health synonyms are expanded (BP = blood pressure, fibre = fiber, salt = sodium) and a query that finds nothing is retried once against close spellings, so a simple typo still finds the tip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum tips to return, clamped to the range 1-200.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of matching tips to skip, for paging. Pair with has_more in the response.

200.description: Matching tips plus the unpaginated total.

get.summary: Return one tip for today, rotating daily and excluding warning signs.
get.description: Stable for the whole day and identical for every user. Warning-sign tips are deliberately excluded: they belong in the always-visible emergency card rather than a once-a-day slot. Returns null (not an error) when the database is not configured, so a databaseless boot still renders the app.

200.description: Today's tip, or null when no database is configured.

404.description: No tips are available to rotate through.

get.summary: Summarise clinical-review coverage of the tip library.
get.description: Counts how many tips carry a review date, and how many are past their review interval (REVIEW_INTERVAL_MONTHS, default 12). Reviewer identities are not published here. A tip with no review date counts as due: not-reviewed must never read as approved.

get.summary: List the tip ids this caller has saved.
get.description: Favourites are keyed by the platform's SSO email header when present, otherwise by the X-Client-Id header the frontend supplies. With neither, an empty list and a note are returned.

parameters.name: X-Client-Id
parameters.description: Stable per-browser identifier used to key favourites when SSO is not enabled.

parameters.name: tip_id
parameters.description: Id of the tip to save or unsave.

post.summary: Save a tip to the caller's favourites.
post.description: Idempotent: saving an already-saved tip succeeds without creating a duplicate.

201.description: The tip is saved (or was already).

404.description: No tip exists with that id.

409.description: This user already has the maximum number of saved tips (MAX_FAVOURITES_PER_USER, default 500).

429.description: Too many favourite changes in the last minute (WRITE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE, default 30).

delete.summary: Remove a tip from the caller's favourites.
delete.description: Idempotent: removing a tip that is not saved still succeeds.

200.description: The tip is no longer saved.

title.description: App display title, from the APP_TITLE environment variable.

identified.description: True when an SSO identity was supplied.

category.description: Category slug. Known values: warning, nutrition, activity, medication, monitoring, lifestyle.

body.description: The tip itself, in plain prose.

why.description: Short rationale for why the tip helps.

sort_order.description: Display ordering key; lower sorts first.

reviewed_on.description: Date of the last clinical review, or null when the tip has never been clinically reviewed. Null is the honest state and must not be presented as approval.

reviewed_by.description: Name of the clinician who signed the tip off, or null.

source.description: Guideline or source the tip is based on, or null when not yet recorded.

total.description: Total matching tips before the limit was applied.

note.description: Diagnostic message, e.g. when the database is not configured.

has_more.description: True when offset + returned tips is less than total, i.e. another page exists.

reviewed.description: Tips with a review date recorded.

due_for_review.description: Tips never reviewed or last reviewed longer than interval_months ago.

all_current.description: True only when every tip has a review inside the interval.

note.description: Diagnostic message, e.g. when no user identity was supplied.
